method.npm: npm audit --json (omit=dev and full tree) against package-lock.json
method.gating: CI gates at critical severity (npm --audit-level=critical; deno audit --level critical). High findings without an upstream fix are risk-accepted or application-layer mitigated and documented here.

findings.advisory: GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification accepts extra nested DigestAlgorithm elements
findings.reachability: build tooling only; not in app runtime bundle
findings.remediation: FIXED — npm audit fix bumped to 1.4.2; npm test/typecheck green after

findings.advisory: GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 memory exhaustion validating oversized constrained collections
findings.compatibility_risk: high — zod 4 is a major; @expo/cli and eslint-plugin-react-hooks (via zod-validation-error) declare zod ^3; forcing 4.x can break Expo CLI and lint
findings.reachability: not reachable: zod schemas here validate developer-authored config at build/lint time, never attacker-controlled runtime input
findings.remediation: RISK-ACCEPTED — build/dev-time only; no compatible fix; monitor for upstream updates
findings.compensating_controls: no runtime exposure; CI audit artifact keeps the finding visible each run

findings.fixed_version: none published (4.3.1 is latest; verified via npm view deepmerge versions)
findings.reachability: not reachable: used by @expo/config on developer-authored app config at build time
findings.remediation: RISK-ACCEPTED — no upstream fix; monitor for 4.3.2+

findings.advisory: npm audit resolves the zod/deepmerge advisories through @expo/cli
findings.compatibility_risk: high — downgrading Expo SDK 58 to 51 would break the app; rejected
findings.reachability: not reachable at runtime; CLI/build-time only
findings.remediation: RISK-ACCEPTED — the only npm-proposed fix is a two-major SDK downgrade; unacceptable

findings.advisory: GHSA-jr5w-w6x2-84p9 mitigation for compromised eMudhra intermediate certificates
findings.remediation: FIXED — npm audit fix bumped to 44.10.0; desktop tsc + 92 tests green after

findings.advisory: multiple (GHSA-4qv8-2p9j-2685, GHSA-f72v-6w45-q472, GHSA-xjj6-f33q-929c, GHSA-4w7w-5xrc-9h26, GHSA-2m5v-pch6-74hx, GHSA-qrxm-fqhp-jwvm, GHSA-9fm3-97px-rjf6, GHSA-55wc-3pg8-jfw6)
findings.remediation: FIXED — bumped to 7.30.1 with the electron update

findings.advisory: GHSA-w74x-v6f9-j3xg, GHSA-xhq7-xmqj-769h, GHSA-wjr9-j795-jxcr, GHSA-333x-w4r6-6crp (URI scheme spoofing, path equivalence, host confusion, scheme injection)
GHSA-hmw2-7cc7-3qxx CRLF injection in form-data multipart field names/filenames
findings.compatibility_risk: high — downgrade rejected; instead bumped core to 19.2.1 (latest minor) and overrode form-data
findings.reachability: the integration only sends our own fields/filenames, but the override removes the vulnerable path entirely
findings.remediation: FIXED — zapier-platform-core 19.2.1 + overrides form-data ^4.0.6; npm audit clean; zapier tests pass

findings.compatibility_risk: unreachable upstream — even pptxgenjs@4.0.1 (latest) declares image-size ^1.2.1; Deno 2.9.7 overrides do not apply to transitive npm deps (verified: deno install kept 1.2.1)
findings.reachability: REACHABLE — make-deck embeds user photos from storage as data URIs; pptxgenjs runs them through image-size
findings.remediation: MITIGATED — application-layer guard: _shared/imageGuard.ts magic-byte allowlist (JPEG/PNG only) applied in make-deck before embedding; non-conforming photos are skipped and logged; 4 unit tests. Vulnerable parsers (ICNS/JXL/HEIF) can no longer receive attacker-controlled bytes.
findings.compensating_controls: make-deck now rejects every non-JPEG/PNG payload; residual risk limited to image-size bugs in JPEG/PNG parsing

findings.advisory: GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq JXL and HEIF parser infinite loops (DoS)
findings.remediation: MITIGATED — same guard as DEP-010 (JXL/HEIF magic bytes rejected in tests)
